description: Runs a callback when an explicit source (ref, getter, reactive object or array of them) changes. Receives new and old values.
Runs immediately and re-runs whenever any reactive value it read changes. Tracks only reads before the first `await`.
Watch options: run right away, traverse nested data (a number limits depth since 3.5), or fire a single time.
Returned by watchers: call it (or `.stop()`) to stop, `.pause()` / `.resume()` (3.5+) to suspend.
